blocks.text: ABO system Landsteiner ne 1901 mein daryaft kiya. Us ne red blood cells (RBCs) par do antigens paye: antigen-A aur antigen-B. Us ne dekha ke kuch logon ke RBCs par antigen-A hai aur kuch par antigen-B, aur bohat se logon mein in mein se koi bhi nahi. Baad mein Landsteiner ke shagirdon ne dekha ke kuch logon ke RBCs par A aur B dono antigens hain. Is liye blood groups ke naam yun rakhe gaye:

items: Antigen-A wale log: blood group A
Antigen-B wale log: blood group B
Antigen-A aur antigen-B dono wale log: blood group AB
Na antigen-A na antigen-B wale log: blood group O

blocks.text: Har shakhs ke blood plasma mein us antigen ke khilaf antibodies hoti hain jo us ke apne RBCs par nahi:

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Kuch log A aur B antigens jism ke mayi (body fluids) jaise thook (saliva), aansu aur peshab mein bhi chhorte hain. Un ke chromosome 19 par aik dominant secretor gene 'Se' hota hai.
Ise Landsteiner ka antigen–antibody relationship ka qaida kehte hain.
